columns.name: INDEXING_EVENT_ID
columns.description: ID field associated with the indexing event

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the event. DONE, RUNNING

columns.name: ENTITY
columns.description: Entity the event is for oracle:apps:hcm:hwr:globalprofile

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: The date when the indexing event ended.

columns.name: SNAPSHOT
columns.description: Snapshot manifest of the files in repo

columns.name: DOCS_IN_STREAM_COUNT
columns.description: Number of documents in stream for the event.

columns.name: DOCS_IN_INDEX
columns.description: Number of document in the main index

columns.name: INDEX_SIZE
columns.description: Total size of the snapshot on disk in KB

columns.name: TOTAL_TIME
columns.description: TOTAL_TIME column to track the total time of the indexing event.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: ERROR message associated with the event.

columns.name: SERVER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the sever this action ran on

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
